description: Canonical real-estate ontology for REDIP. Single source of truth for area / pricing / deal-structure / exit-strategy taxonomies + extraction field mappings. Bengaluru-priority, India-context. Used by document ingestion (extraction.service), apply-extractions endpoint, deal export builders, frontend form validation.

asset_class.description: 10 native asset classes REDIP underwrites. Anything else routes through 'mixed_use' or 'raw_land' depending on entitlement stage. Per CLAUDE.md the primary nav axis.

values.label: Hospitality (hotel)
values.india_notes: USALI cost structure; ADR + RevPAR + OCC% KPIs; STR / branded vs unbranded keys distinct on tax/financing.

values.label: Commercial Office
values.india_notes: Grade A vs B; CBD vs SBD vs PBD rental tiers; vacancy in Bengaluru micro-markets (ORR, EPIP, KIADB) varies 8-22%.

values.label: Retail
values.india_notes: Anchor + vanilla rent split; CAM + revenue-share variants; high-street vs mall vs neighborhood retail.

values.label: Industrial / Warehousing
values.india_notes: Grade A + Class A warehouse rent ₹22-32/sqft/month; KIADB/KUM logistics parks; truck dock density matters.

values.label: Residential Apartments
values.india_notes: RERA escrow 70/30 milestone economics; sale rate ₹/sqft based on saleable area (SBA); GST 5% with no ITC for under-construction.

values.label: Villas / Row Houses
values.india_notes: Luxury premium framing; plot + built-up split; smaller cohort sizes; longer sales cycle (12-18 months).

values.label: Plotted Development
values.india_notes: Karnataka conversion (DC) fee; layout approval from BDA/BMRDA/BBMP; PRR connectivity premium.

values.label: Mixed-Use Development
values.india_notes: Component blend across residential / office / retail / hospitality; share-by-area or share-by-revenue accounting.

values.label: Redevelopment (JDA)
values.india_notes: JDA area-share or revenue-share with landowner; existing-society approvals; relocation costs.

values.label: Raw Land (entitlement pipeline)
values.india_notes: Pre-conversion entitlement risk; KIADB / KUM acquisition vs private; months-to-conversion pipeline.

deal_structure.description: How the deal is structured between developer and landowner. Drives capital-stack accounting + exit-economics. Mirrors the deals.deal_structure values enforced by the API (backend/src/constants/domain.js DEAL_STRUCTURES); contract-tested against the backend + frontend on every CI run. Reconciled to the live 8-key taxonomy per the operator decision of 2026-05-22.

values.label: Outright Purchase
values.india_notes: Developer pays the full land cost upfront; equity + debt sit on the total project cost.

values.label: JV (Joint Venture)
values.india_notes: Jointly-owned SPV — landowner and developer co-invest and share returns by equity stake; the JV holds title.

values.label: JDA (Development Agreement)
values.india_notes: Joint Development Agreement — landowner contributes the land, developer builds, no upfront land payment; share terms set per deal.

values.label: Revenue Share
values.india_notes: Landowner takes an agreed share of project revenue; developer funds all construction. No upfront land payment.

values.label: Area Share
values.india_notes: Landowner takes a share of built-up area (units / sqft) to monetise independently; developer funds construction.

values.label: Profit Share
values.india_notes: Landowner and developer split net project profit after costs, rather than gross revenue or built-up area.

values.label: Ground Lease
values.india_notes: Land is leased for a long tenure rather than sold; developer builds and operates, and the asset reverts on lease expiry.

values.label: Hybrid
values.india_notes: A blended structure combining elements of the above (e.g. part upfront payment, part area share); terms are deal-specific.

exit_strategy.description: Exit strategies are FAMILY-CONDITIONAL. Income-family deals have different exits than development-family deals. Surfacing the wrong exit list on the UI is a red flag.

income.label: Strategic Sale (full asset)
income.india_notes: Full stabilized-asset sale to PE / REIT / strategic buyer at cap-rate price.

income.label: REIT Exit
income.india_notes: Contribution to a SEBI-registered REIT; minimum 25% public float; income-distributing.

income.label: Refinance + Hold
income.india_notes: Refi to LRD post-stabilization, hold for cash-flow; common in office + retail.

income.label: Hold to Perpetuity
income.india_notes: Operator-owned long-term; appears in family-office / sovereign-fund deals.

development.label: Outright Sale (progressive)
development.india_notes: Sales close progressively as construction milestones complete; RERA escrow 70/30.

development.label: Bulk Exit on Completion
development.india_notes: Bulk B2B exit to a single institutional buyer post-OC; common in BTR plays.

development.label: Hold post completion
development.india_notes: Developer holds units post-OC for lease; converts development to income-family economics.

land.label: Strategic Sale of entitled land
land.india_notes: Sell post-conversion to a developer / fund at the entitlement premium.

land.label: JDA with downstream developer
land.india_notes: Enter JDA after entitlements complete; capture downstream development upside.

zoning.description: The coarse property-classification taxonomy — mirrors the 5-value Postgres `zoning_type` enum used by properties.zoning and deals.zoning (see database/schema.sql). Contract-tested against backend/src/constants/domain.js ZONING_TYPES + the frontend on every CI run. The detailed Karnataka RMP 2031 zone codes (R1/R2, Public & Semi-Public, etc.) are a separate, richer dataset held in master_plan_zones — not this enum.

ownership_type.description: Title-status taxonomy. Drives DD work + exit haircuts. A-khata vs B-khata is a major Bengaluru valuation factor (default 15% haircut on B-khata at exit).

area.description: Area unit definitions. India RE practice uses sqft / acres / sqyd / sqm interchangeably; canonical normalization is sqft. SBA / BUA / Carpet conversions are RANGES — pick the midpoint when no specific ratio is documented.

GFA.label: Gross Floor Area
GFA.description: Total built area including walls, terraces, common areas. Permission basis.

BUA.label: Built-Up Area
BUA.description: Net usable area excluding terraces. Construction-cost basis.

SBA.label: Super Built-Up Area
SBA.description: BUA + pro-rata common areas. Selling basis (residential).

Carpet.label: Carpet Area (RERA)
Carpet.description: Net habitable floor area excluding walls. RERA-mandated disclosure since 2017.

Rentable.label: Rentable Area (BOMA)
Rentable.description: Leasing basis for office; close to BUA + lobby + corridor.

sba_to_carpet.notes: Typical residential SBA→Carpet ratio. Use 0.70 default when unspecified.

sba_to_bua.notes: Typical residential SBA→BUA ratio. Use 0.88 default.

pricing.description: Pricing unit definitions. Bengaluru land deals commonly quoted in ₹ Cr total OR ₹/sqft OR ₹/acre. Normalization to ₹/sqft (per land area) for downstream comp benchmarking.

extraction_field_map.description: Maps canonical extraction-field keys to their destination table + column in REDIP's DB schema. Used by the apply-extractions endpoint to route each approved extraction value to the correct write path. Each entry includes: table, column, value_type, optional transform (for unit-conversion or basis-change), description, and an india_context note explaining WHY this matters.

survey_number.label: Survey Number
survey_number.description: Karnataka Revenue survey number (e.g. '45/2A, 45/2B'). Often comma- or slash-separated.
survey_number.india_context: Survey numbers are the primary identifier for rural / sub-urban Karnataka land. Bhoomi / RTC linkage.

pid.label: PID Number
pid.india_context: BBMP-jurisdiction urban properties carry PID; rural ones don't. Used for property-tax lookup.

khata_number.label: Khata Number
khata_number.description: BBMP Khata extract number — the ownership ledger entry.
khata_number.india_context: A-Khata (regularized) vs B-Khata (irregular) is a major valuation factor; default 15% haircut on B-Khata at exit.

bhoomi_id.label: Bhoomi ID
bhoomi_id.description: Karnataka Bhoomi land-records ID. Used to fetch RTC / Pahani extract.
bhoomi_id.india_context: Bhoomi linkage required to verify rural-land title. Direct API access is BLOCKED — operator must manually fetch RTC.

owner_name.label: Owner Name
owner_name.description: Registered owner per sale deed / khata extract.
owner_name.india_context: Compare against promoter name to flag potential conflict-of-interest in JDA deals.

land_area_sqft.label: Land Area (sqft)
land_area_sqft.description: Total land area in square feet. Canonical area unit for storage.
land_area_sqft.india_context: land_area_acres is GENERATED ALWAYS AS land_area_sqft / 43560.0 — never write to acres directly.

land_area_acres.label: Land Area (acres)
land_area_acres.description: Land area in acres. Auto-converted to sqft on write (sqft = acres × 43560).
land_area_acres.india_context: Karnataka rural deals quote in acres or guntha; conversion to sqft on write is mandatory.

road_width_m.label: Abutting Road Width (m)
road_width_m.description: Width of the road abutting the property in meters.
road_width_m.india_context: Karnataka RMP 2031 commercial FAR uplifts triggered at 12m / 18m / 24m road widths. Direct FAR multiplier.

circle_rate_per_sqft.label: Circle Rate (₹/sqft)
circle_rate_per_sqft.description: IGR Karnataka guidance value per sqft. Stamp-duty floor.
circle_rate_per_sqft.india_context: Karnataka stamp duty 6.6% computed on max(consideration, circle_rate × area). IGR SRO publishes ward-wise rates.

permissible_fsi.label: Permissible FSI
permissible_fsi.description: Floor Space Index permissible per zoning + road width.
permissible_fsi.india_context: BBMP residential 1.75-3.25; commercial 2.5-4.0 depending on road width + plot frontage.

existing_fsi.label: Existing FSI
existing_fsi.description: FSI already consumed by existing structures (redevelopment context).

frontage_mtrs.label: Frontage (m)
frontage_mtrs.description: Plot frontage on the abutting road.

ownership_type.label: Ownership Type
ownership_type.description: Title type — freehold / leasehold / a_khata / b_khata / mixed_khata / not_applicable.
ownership_type.india_context: Drives DD scope + exit-pricing haircut. B-Khata default 15% haircut at exit.

encumbrance_status.label: Encumbrance Status
encumbrance_status.description: Whether the property is encumbered (mortgage / lien / litigation pending).

rera_registration_number_property.label: RERA Registration (property-level)
rera_registration_number_property.description: Property-level RERA reg (for ongoing projects with multiple phases).

consideration_inr.label: Sale Consideration (₹)
consideration_inr.description: Total consideration in rupees. Auto-converted to ₹ Crore on write (cr = inr / 10000000).
consideration_inr.india_context: Sale deeds quote in ₹; deals table stores in Crore for analyst readability.

notes.label: Notes / Observations
notes.description: Free-form extraction notes (e.g., 'EC clear except 2019 mortgage to HDFC, satisfied 2023').

confidence_bands.description: How REDIP UI renders raw confidence scores. Per AI_ROADMAP §10 (UX/UI conventions for AI surfaces).

bands.label: High
bands.applies: Auto-fill candidate — operator may accept-all-high in bulk.

bands.label: Medium
bands.applies: Requires explicit per-field review before apply.

bands.label: Low
bands.applies: Surface only as 'verify' suggestion; never auto-fill.
